name: ALTURA Properties
features: properties are their own content type: add or edit one in the admin and it appears on the home slider, the properties page and its own page
full-screen hero slider with wipe transitions, counter and arrows, built from the first six properties
property page with price (or 'Price on request'), beds, baths, size, plot, status and an enquire button
status labels: available, under offer, sold
enquiry form: name, email, phone, property, budget, message; the property is pre-selected from the button you clicked
every enquiry emailed to the agent and saved in the admin with the sent email attached
enquiries inbox with follow-up status (new, contacted, viewing, offer, lost, spam) and CSV export
spam protection without a captcha: honeypot, signed timestamp and a per-visitor rate limit
Google Analytics, Meta Pixel and Search Console IDs in one settings screen, nothing loaded until filled in
scroll reveals in CSS only, reduced motion respected
meta descriptions and Open Graph tags
privacy export/erase wired to WordPress's own privacy tools
block theme, native blocks, block patterns, no page builder
no third-party scripts until tracking IDs are added; automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks (axe) pass
